description: The figure presents two pie charts comparing the distribution of outcome/error categories for a reasoning task, with each chart divided into four slices corresponding to the legend at the top: Atomic Skill Fail (dark teal), Correct (medium teal), Reason Error (light blue), and Question Misunderstood (white). In the right pie chart, the slices are labeled 10.0% for Atomic Skill Fail (dark teal), 55.0% for Correct (medium teal), 21.0% for Reason Error (light blue), and 14.0% for Question Misunderstood (white).
